title: Write new items, not released ones
statement: Write new questions rather than copying or paraphrasing released exam items.
detail: The AP work's stem template for document-based questions ruled out verbatim exam-board prompts and paraphrases of released exams, asking for new stems anchored to verified primary documents. Its inclusion criteria require every pipeline component to be licence- and source-clean: no scraped copyrighted material, no model output used as training data, and no personal data. A re-audit of the source corpus found every encyclopedia row carrying its CC BY-SA 4.0 licence.

evidence.quote: NO verbatim College Board prompts; NO paraphrase of released exams; net-new stems anchored to verified primary documents.
7. **License / source-clean**: no scraped copyrighted material, no Anthropic / OpenAI-output-as-training, no PII
